gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Wiry, wide-grinning letters take the lead in Happy Monkey. Sawarabi Gothic sits beneath it as a sans with open curves, and it holds up fine at a modest size.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-voces: Love Ya Like A Sister looks like pipe cleaners bent into letters, with stubby ascenders. Voces follows in a tall-lowercase plain sans whose reed-pen curves thicken slightly, so the loose, outward-pointing heading gets a steadier partner beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cal-sans: Wide-tracked and wilful, Offside lets its curves refuse to close, holding one level beat. Cal Sans follows in plain sans-serif strokes of single width, with short ascenders and a tall x-height.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-zilla-slab: Bold blocky Pixelify Sans runs its identical bars across the heading line, each c gaping like a bent paperclip. Zilla Slab then settles underneath with sturdy slab-serif curves.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Loose and handwritten, Shantell Sans keeps one pen width throughout, its n arches no thinner than the stems beside them. Encode Sans Semi Condensed then reads smoothly down a page, narrow and approachable.
